cards.text: Jacob, whom God named Israel (Genesis 35:10), just found out his son Joseph is alive and ruling over all the land of Egypt (Genesis 45:26-28). So Israel sets out with all he has, and he comes to a place called Beersheba. Before he goes one step farther, friend, he does something first.

cards.question: Jacob is on his way to Egypt and stops at Beersheba. What does he do there?

answers.text: He digs a new well for water
He buys grain for the long trip

cards.text: That night God speaks to Israel in a vision: "Jacob, Jacob!" "Here I am," Jacob answers, and friend, when somebody says MY name twice like that, I drop the whole batch.
God says, "I am God," the God of Jacob's father, and Jacob doesn't need to be afraid to go down to Egypt. New country, long road, and God says: don't be afraid.

cards.question: God tells Jacob that down in Egypt, He will make him into a great ___.
True or false: God tells Jacob He will go down to Egypt with him.
Along with going down to Egypt with Jacob, what does God say He will surely do?

cards.text: Then God says one more thing to Jacob, and I think it's a tender one: "And Joseph's own hands will close your eyes."

So Jacob leaves Beersheba, and his sons carry him in the wagons Pharaoh, king of Egypt, sent for him. Jacob gets moved in the king's own wagons, and when I got moved, I got carried across the kitchen and slid into a DRAWER.

cards.question: Jacob's family heads for Egypt. True or false: they leave their livestock behind in Canaan.

cards.text: Jacob's sons and grandsons, his daughters and granddaughters, all go down to Egypt, family by family. Counting Joseph's two sons born in Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim, the family comes to seventy in all. Friend, I had six cookie cutter kids on one counter and thought THAT was a crowd.
No map app back then. So Jacob had sent one of his sons ahead to Joseph to get directions to Goshen, a region of Egypt.

cards.question: Jacob sends ___ ahead to Joseph to get directions to Goshen.

cards.text: The family arrives in Goshen, and Joseph gets his chariot ready and goes out to meet his father Israel. No waiting by the window for THIS man.

cards.question: True or false: When Joseph meets his father, he stays up in his chariot and greets him from there.
Joseph is holding his father Israel and weeping. Israel says, "Finally I can die…" Why does he say that?

answers.text: He has seen Joseph is still alive
He is too worn out to go on
He knows Canaan is lost for good

cards.text: Now Joseph's got a plan. He tells the family he'll go tell Pharaoh they've come from Canaan, and that the men are shepherds with their flocks and herds.
Then he gets them ready for Pharaoh's big question: "What is your occupation?" Friend, Joseph is coaching his brothers like it's a JOB INTERVIEW.

cards.question: True or false: Joseph tells his brothers to tell Pharaoh they've raised livestock ever since they were young.
Joseph says that if the brothers tell Pharaoh they raise livestock, they'll be allowed to settle in Goshen. What reason does he give?

cards.text: So Joseph tells Pharaoh his father and brothers are in Goshen with everything they own. Then he picks five of his brothers to meet the king, and I bet the rest of them were just fine sitting that one out.
Pharaoh asks the brothers, "What is your occupation?" They tell him they're shepherds, both they and their fathers.

cards.question: The brothers tell Pharaoh they've come to live in the land for a time. What reason do they give?

answers.text: There's no pasture for their flocks
Their wells in Canaan have run dry

cards.text: Then they ask Pharaoh, please, to let them settle in the land of Goshen. Pharaoh answers, but he says it to Joseph.

cards.question: True or false: Pharaoh tells Joseph to settle his family in the poorest part of the land.
Pharaoh adds an offer: if Joseph knows any talented men among his brothers, put them in charge of Pharaoh's own ___.

cards.text: Then Joseph brings in his father Jacob and presents him before Pharaoh. A shepherd from Canaan, face to face with the king of Egypt.

cards.question: True or false: When Jacob stands before Pharaoh, Jacob blesses him.
Pharaoh asks Jacob, "How many years have you lived?" Jacob says his travels have lasted ___ years.
Jacob tells Pharaoh his years haven't matched the years of his fathers' travels. How does he describe his own years?

cards.text: Then Jacob blesses Pharaoh again and leaves. Friend, the man walks in to meet the king of Egypt and blesses him on the way IN and on the way OUT.
So Joseph settles his father and brothers in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

cards.question: Joseph's family now has property in Egypt. What else does Joseph provide for his father's whole household?

cards.text: Keep that apron on, friend, because this family's story is a long way from finished.
